name: io.github.ClicheFactory/clichefactory-mcp
title: ClicheFactory Document Intelligence
description: Extract structured JSON from PDFs, images, DOCX, XLSX, CSV, EML attachments, and DSPy pipelines.

environmentVariables.name: CLICHEFACTORY_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: ClicheFactory API key (required). Create at clichefactory.com → Settings → API Keys.

environmentVariables.name: CLICHEFACTORY_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional ClicheFactory API base URL override.

environmentVariables.name: LLM_MODEL_NAME
environmentVariables.description: Optional — model name for local/BYOK mode only.

environmentVariables.name: LLM_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional — LLM provider API key for local/BYOK mode only.
